instruction: I am an assistant professor in the Computer Science Department at the University of Hong Kong. I plan to apply for the General Research Fund next year and need to gain some insights, so please help me organize the data. First, please help me compile the approval rates for General Research Fund applications from computer science departments of various universities from 2019 to 2023, presented as percentages (rounded to two decimal places), and put them in a table for my subsequent use. Set the headers as Year, Number of Applications, Number of Grants, and Success Rate. Related materials are saved in the Documents/Fundings path. And please save the result table as a GRF-p5y.xlsx file on the desktop.
